debts.name: Credit card
notes: Interest is estimated monthly (yearly rate / 12). Most cards charge daily, so real interest can be slightly higher.
The payment stays the same each month. A card's minimum payment usually shrinks as the balance drops, which takes much longer.
Promotional rates, fees and penalty rates are not included.
